subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lessons 10–11: Over to you!, Review and Get ready for…
outcomes: I can review Unit 3 places, parts of buildings and relative pronouns.
I can use the Past continuous with the Past simple.
I can use exam tips and understand the story ‘Be an Architect’ Day.

tf.s: In Petra, the writer walked along streets where people walked 2,000 years ago.
tf.why: Petra is an ancient city with very old streets.

tf.s: A skyscraper is a tall building which has lots of floors.
When you finish a cloze task, you should never read the text again.
tf.why: The tip is: read the whole text again when you finish.

tf.s: An architect visited the class in the graded reader.
tf.why: The architect came for ‘Be an Architect’ Day.

tf.s: The prize for the best model was a building set.
tf.why: A building set was the prize.

tf.s: Only one student won the prize.
In the story, the sports centre has plants on the roof.
tf.why: The plants are on the roof, not at the entrance.

tf.s: “The castle who I made has 30 tiny steps.” is correct.
tf.why: A castle is a thing, so we use that: The castle that I made …

tf.s: “They were playing when the lights went out.” is correct.
tf.why: Past continuous for the longer action, Past simple for the shorter one.

tf.s: An architect is a person who cooks in a restaurant.

boxes.q: Complete: A skyscraper is a tall building which has lots of ___.
Choose: There are (factories / apartments / castles) in some skyscrapers.
boxes.why: People live in apartments in skyscrapers.

boxes.q: Choose: I don’t like going up and down in a (lift / roof / floor).
boxes.why: A lift goes up and down.
An architect visited for ‘Be an Architect’ Day.

boxes.q: Complete: That’s the factory ___ my dad works.
boxes.why: A factory is a place: where.

boxes.q: Complete: I was ___ at a laptop when a famous actor walked in.
What should you do before you listen?
o: Look at the picture and text.
boxes.why: Looking first helps you know what to listen for.

hunt.q: Goes up and down a building
The prize for the best model
Plants are on the ___ of the sports centre.

mcq.q: What did the girls use to make models?
o: cardboard boxes, plastic bottles, paper straws, paint and glue
mcq.why: They used things like boxes, bottles and straws.

mcq.q: Which exam tip helps with cloze tasks?
o: When you finish, read the whole text again.
Choose the first answer you see.
mcq.why: Re-reading helps you check your answers.

mcq.q: What did the writer do in Petra?
o: climbed steps and walked along very old streets

mcq.q: What is the Unit 3 WOW! Question?
o: Why are some places and buildings important to us?

mcq.q: Make a sentence: they / play / when / the lights / go out
o: They were playing when the lights went out.
They was playing when the lights went out.
They played when the lights were go out.
They were play when the lights going out.
mcq.why: were + -ing, then the Past simple went.

mcq.q: Which sentence about your town is correct?
o: I visit the sports centre every week. I play basketball there.
I visits the sports centre every week.
I visiting the sports centre every week.
I am visit the sports centre every week.
mcq.why: Present simple with I: I visit, I play.

mcq.q: Choose the correct relative pronoun: An architect is a person ___ designs buildings.
mcq.why: An architect is a person: who.

mcq.q: Why are some places important to us?
o: They hold special memories and teach us about history.
mcq.why: Places connect us with our memories and the past.

mcq.q: The architect gave the prize to everyone. What is a good reason to agree?
o: Everyone worked hard and made a good model.
The architect didn’t look at the models.
mcq.why: A good opinion gives a reason that fits the story.

o: That’s the factory who my dad works.
That’s the factory where my dad works.
He’s the architect who visited us.
It’s the model that I made.
mcq.why: A factory is a place, so we need where.
